data.name: Behasht
data.gender_notes: Behasht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of divine origin, signifying a place of ultimate peace and serenity, reminiscent of the beautiful gardens in paradise as described in Islamic spiritual traditions. The name Behasht carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Behasht usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blissful and peaceful state of the soul in the presence of Allah.
data.etymology: Behasht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Behasht total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: بھشت
in_arabic.long_meaning: بھشت هو اسم يدل على الجنة أو الفردوس، وهو أعلى مراتب الجنة في الإسلام. يأتي من الجذر العربي 'ب-ه-ش' الذي يعني الفرح والسرور. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كوصف للجنة التي ينتظرها المؤمنون.

in_urdu.name: بہشت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہشت ایک ایسا نام ہے جو جنت یا فردوس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور یہ جنت کی اعلیٰ مراتب ہے۔ یہ عربی جذر 'ب-ه-ش' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فرح اور سرور۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر انعامات کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے جو مؤمنین کو انتظار ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बेहश्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: बेहश्त एक ऐसा नाम है जो स्वर्ग या उच्चतम स्वर्ग को दर्शाता है। यह अरबी मूल 'ब-ह-श' से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है खुशी और आनंद। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका उल्लेख उन पुरस्कारों के रूप में किया गया है जिनकी प्रतीक्षा विश्वासी करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: بھشت
in_pashto.long_meaning: بھشت دى يو نوم چې د جنت يا فردوس په معنا دی. دا د عربي ريښو 'ب-ه-ش' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د خوښۍ او خوشحالۍ معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې د مؤمنانو د انعام په توګه ياد شوی دی.

It is also a common name in the Islamic world, reflecting the cultural significance of gardens and greenery in Islamic art, literature, and spirituality.

It is described as a beautiful garden, filled with fruit trees, flowing rivers, and other delightful features. The name Behasht thus carries a deep spiritual significance, representing a heavenly destination that promises eternal peace and happiness to believers. The name is a reminder of the blessings of Allah, and an inspiration to live a virtuous life in the hope of attaining this beautiful paradise.
